name: Bachelor of Veterinary Science
notes: Closing date 31 May (earlier than other faculties). Selection by Merit Point Score within categories; may include interviews or additional tests. School leavers conditionally selected on Grade 11 results; place lost if final NSC fails minimum requirements or final MPS is more than 5% below Grade 11 score. Applicants must not have registered at any higher education institution. Only Mathematics accepted (Maths Lit and Technical Maths not considered). Suggested second choices: BSc Zoology or BSc Agriculture in Animal Science.
